note: A scattered delivery with a dense floor edge (chapter 15.4 B-100): per second of send time 40 % of the seconds sit on the floor and the rest 50-250 ms above it; the source clock slow by 50 ppm, so the lock must read +50. The floor seconds hold under half of the buckets, so the first fit waits for the full window; its densest band is the floor's edge and reads the clock: +49.5 ppm at 306 s (the accuracy pin: a zero first fit or a whole-window fit fails it). Today's rule never locks this trace in 600 s.
